result.signature: (ht : t.Finite) (hsub : s ⊂ t) : Nat.card s < Nat.card t
result.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {s t : Set α}, t.Finite → s ⊂ t → Nat.card ↑s < Nat.card ↑t
result.value:
:= by
  have : Fintype t := Finite.fintype ht
  have : Fintype s := Finite.fintype (subset ht (subset_of_ssubset hsub))
  simp only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  exact Set.card_lt_card hsub
result.informal_description: For any finite set $ t $ and its proper subset $ s $, the cardinality of $ s $ is less than the cardinality of $ t $, i.e., $ |s| < |t| $.

:=
  Fintype.card_lt_of_injective_not_surjective (Set.inclusion h.1) (Set.inclusion_injective h.1) fun hst =>
    (ssubset_iff_subset_ne.1 h).2 (eq_of_inclusion_surjective hst)
result.informal_name: Cardinality of Proper Subset is Strictly Less
result.informal_description: For finite sets $ s $ and $ t $ over a type $ \alpha $, if $ s $ is a proper subset of $ t $ (denoted $ s \subset t $), then the cardinality of $ s $ is strictly less than the cardinality of $ t $, i.e., $ \#s < \#t $.

name: Finset
exists_sum_fiber_le_of_sum_fiber_nonneg_of_sum_le_nsmul
result.signature:
(hf : ∀ y ∉ t, (0 : M) ≤ ∑ x ∈ s with f x = y, w x) (ht : t.Nonempty) (hb : ∑ x ∈ s, w x ≤ #t • b) :
  ∃ y ∈ t, ∑ x ∈ s with f x = y, w x ≤ b
result.type:
∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {M : Type w} [inst : DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {t : Finset β} {f : α → β} {w : α → M}
  {b : M} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : LinearOrder M] [IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid M],
  (∀ y ∉ t, 0 ≤ ∑ x ∈ s with f x = y, w x) →
    t.Nonempty → ∑ x ∈ s, w x ≤ t.card • b → ∃ y ∈ t, ∑ x ∈ s with f x = y, w x ≤ b
result.informal_description: Let $ s $ be a finite set, $ f $ a function from $ s $ to some type, and $ w $ a weight function assigning non-negative values to elements of $ s $. Suppose that for every $ y $ not in a non-empty finite set $ t $, the sum $ \sum_{x \in s, f(x) = y} w(x) \geq 0 $. If the total sum $ \sum_{x \in s} w(x) \leq \#t \cdot b $, then there exists an element $ y \in t $ such that $ \sum_{x \in s, f(x) = y} w(x) \leq b $.

name: Finsupp
le_weight
result.signature: (w : σ → ℕ) {s : σ} (hs : w s ≠ 0) (f : σ →₀ ℕ) : f s ≤ weight w f
result.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (w : σ → ℕ) {s : σ}, w s ≠ 0 → ∀ (f : σ →₀ ℕ), f s ≤ (Finsupp.weight w) f
result.value:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [weight_apply, Finsupp.sum]
  by_cases h : s ∈ f.support
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_add_sum_diff_singleton h]
    refine le_trans ?_ (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
    apply Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right
    exact Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero hs
  · simp only [notMem_support_iff] at h
    rw [h]
    apply zero_le
result.informal_name: Weighted Sum Inequality for Finite Support Functions
result.informal_description: For any function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, element $ s \in \sigma $ with $ w(s) \neq 0 $, and finite support function $ f : \sigma \to_0 \mathbb{N} $, the value $ f(s) $ is less than or equal to the weighted sum $ \sum_{t \in \text{support } f} w(t) \cdot f(t) $.

name: finsum_nonneg
result.signature:
∀ {α : Sort u_4} {M : Type u_7} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedAddMonoid M] {f : α → M},
  (∀ (i : α), 0 ≤ f i) → 0 ≤ ∑ᶠ (i : α), f i
result.type:
∀ {α : Sort u_4} {M : Type u_7} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedAddMonoid M] {f : α → M},
  (∀ (i : α), 0 ≤ f i) → 0 ≤ ∑ᶠ (i : α), f i
result.informal_name: Non-negativity of Finite Sums in Ordered Additive Monoids
result.informal_description: In an ordered additive commutative monoid $M$, if every element $f(i)$ in a function $f : \alpha \to M$ satisfies $0 \leq f(i)$, then the finite sum $\sum^\mathrm{fin}_{i : \alpha} f(i)$ is also non-negative, i.e., $0 \leq \sum^\mathrm{fin}_{i : \alpha} f(i)$.

name: Finset
sum_le_univ_sum_of_nonneg
result.signature:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : PartialOrder N] {f : ι → N} [AddLeftMono N]
  [inst_3 : Fintype ι] {s : Finset ι}, (∀ (x : ι), 0 ≤ f x) → ∑ x ∈ s, f x ≤ ∑ x, f x
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : PartialOrder N] {f : ι → N} [AddLeftMono N]
  [inst_3 : Fintype ι] {s : Finset ι}, (∀ (x : ι), 0 ≤ f x) → ∑ x ∈ s, f x ≤ ∑ x, f x
result.informal_name: Subset Sum Inequality for Non-Negative Elements in Additive Monoid
result.informal_description: For any finite type $\iota$ and additive commutative monoid $N$ equipped with a partial order where addition is monotonic, if $f : \iota \to N$ is a function such that $0 \leq f(x)$ for all $x \in \iota$, then for any finite subset $s \subseteq \iota$, the sum $\sum_{x \in s} f(x)$ is less than or equal to the total sum $\sum_{x \in \iota} f(x)$.

name: Hindman
FS
rec
result.signature:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : AddSemigroup M] {motive : (a : Stream' M) → (a_1 : M) → Hindman.FS a a_1 → Prop},
  (∀ (a : Stream' M), motive a a.head ⋯) →
    (∀ (a : Stream' M) (m : M) (h : Hindman.FS a.tail m), motive a.tail m h → motive a m ⋯) →
      (∀ (a : Stream' M) (m : M) (h : Hindman.FS a.tail m), motive a.tail m h → motive a (a.head + m) ⋯) →
        ∀ {a : Stream' M} {a_1 : M} (t : Hindman.FS a a_1), motive a a_1 t
result.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : AddSemigroup M] {motive : (a : Stream' M) → (a_1 : M) → Hindman.FS a a_1 → Prop},
  (∀ (a : Stream' M), motive a a.head ⋯) →
    (∀ (a : Stream' M) (m : M) (h : Hindman.FS a.tail m), motive a.tail m h → motive a m ⋯) →
      (∀ (a : Stream' M) (m : M) (h : Hindman.FS a.tail m), motive a.tail m h → motive a (a.head + m) ⋯) →
        ∀ {a : Stream' M} {a_1 : M} (t : Hindman.FS a a_1), motive a a_1 t
result.informal_name: Recursor for finite sums in an additive semigroup
result.informal_description: A recursion principle for the set of finite sums of an infinite sequence in an additive semigroup. Given a property to prove for all finite sums, it suffices to verify: (1) the base case where the sum is the head element of the sequence; (2) the tail case where the sum comes from the tail sequence; and (3) the cons case where the sum is the head element added to a sum from the tail. This allows defining functions or proving properties by induction on the structure of finite sums.
